description: VYBE Music v4.1.7 — Animated Dynamic Island with Live Equalizer Waveform, Instagram & Social Video Music Identifier, and Real-Time Cross-Device Admin Push Notifications.

announcement.title: Welcome To VYBE Music
announcement.message: Welcome to VYBE Music! Enjoy infinite ad-free music, animated dynamic island, beat sync party mode, and liquid glass navigation.

changelog.title: Animated Dynamic Island with Equalizer Waveform
items: Live 4-Bar Equalizer Waveform: Bouncing audio visualizer animates in sync with music playback at the top pill
Fluid Spring-Physics Morphing: Smooth expand & collapse transitions with physics-based spring damping
Compact & Expanded Control States: Rotating vinyl artwork, marquee scrolling song title, scrub bar, and one-tap player expansion

changelog.title: Instagram Reels, TikTok & Shorts Music Identifier
items: Direct Share-to-Identify: Share any video link from Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts into VYBE Music
Intelligent Audio Extraction: Automatically resolves background music track and artist names from video page metadata
One-Tap Instant Playback: Matched song badge appears in Dynamic Island with single-tap queue playback

changelog.title: Real-Time Cross-Device Admin Push Notifications
items: Instant Multi-Phone Delivery: Notifications sent from Admin Screen broadcast immediately across all member devices via pub/sub cloud relay
Automatic Catch-Up Sync: Offline devices automatically receive queued announcements on app startup or periodic background sync
System Sound & Vibration: High-priority heads-up notifications with tap-to-open navigation and in-app home banner

changelog.title: Liquid Glass Navigation & Listen Together Beat Sync
items: Frosted Liquid Glass Navigation: Specular translucent bottom pill with smooth spring tab glide
Sub-20ms Drift Sync: Hardware-accelerated bass boost and exact millisecond party mode playback
